rules: For each attainable fidelity, call the fixed aggressive checkpoint first.
A clairvoyant oracle stops at the early checkpoint iff its fresh paired F1 reaches the requested fidelity; otherwise it calls depth10.
Depth10 requests make exactly one call.
Charge prompt plus generated tokens for every call; charge selected prefix context tokens for final-context accounting.
This is a hindsight ceiling and supplies no deployable decision rule.
Use no sealed split and make no new Target calls.
